findings.desc: Real authority_enforce_runner --live CLI dispatch is not story-scoped. The public command schema for authority_enforce_runner omits both live and storyId (packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:1993), and CLI validation builds z.object(tool.schema) for non-autopilot commands (packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:425), so unknown --live/--storyId flags are stripped before handler dispatch. The implementation only added handler types/options, and the smoke calls runAuthorityEnforceRunner() directly (packages/main/src/tasks/authority-runner-client-smoke.ts:621), bypassing CLI parsing/validation. As a result the real lattice authority_enforce_runner --live --storyId=B-current path does not reach runLatticeAuthorityControlPlaneOnce with storyId and does not prove or send signed claim.storyId from the actual command path.
